Class Panel.Builder

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.api.panel.Panel.Builder
Enclosing class:
Panel
public static final class Panel.Builder extends Object
Fluent builder for Panel. Mirrors the full positional constructor's parameters as named, optional setters with sensible defaults (visible, PanelStyle.RAISED, PanelPosition.UNPLACED, no toggle key). The -1 no-toggle-key sentinel is hidden behind toggleKey(int), leaving it unset means "no key."

  • Method Details

    • elements

      public Panel.Builder elements(List<? extends PanelElement> elements)
      Replaces the accumulated element list with the given one. Additive with add(PanelElement), call order is: this resets the list, subsequent add(...) append to it.

    • add

      public Panel.Builder add(PanelElement element)
      Appends a single element to the panel's element list.

    • visible

      public Panel.Builder visible(boolean visible)
      Sets the initial visibility state. Default true.

    • visibleWhen

      public Panel.Builder visibleWhen(BooleanSupplier condition)
      Shows the panel only while condition holds, read every frame: the same word every element's builder uses (§0066, §0068). See Panel.visibleWhen(BooleanSupplier).

    • style

      public Panel.Builder style(PanelStyle style)
      Sets the panel's visual background style. Default PanelStyle.RAISED.

    • position

      public Panel.Builder position(PanelPosition position)
      Sets where the panel sits: the one placement every host reads (§0065). Default PanelPosition.UNPLACED: adapters and the HUD reject an unplaced panel; MKScreen and CustomContainerMenu make the first unplaced panel their main() and stack later ones below it.

    • toggleKey

      public Panel.Builder toggleKey(int glfwKeyCode)
      Sets the GLFW key code that toggles this panel's visibility. Leave unset for no toggle key, there is no need to pass the -1 sentinel by hand.

    • disabledWhen

      public Panel.Builder disabledWhen(BooleanSupplier condition)
      Disables the whole panel while condition holds, read every frame: every element draws greyed and takes no input (the disabled cascade, §0066). See Panel.disabledWhen(BooleanSupplier).

    • build

      public Panel build()
      Builds the configured Panel.
